notes.summary: Geography gives about 2–3 questions: India's location and latitudes, rivers and dams, soils, the atmosphere, and a few 'largest / longest / highest' world facts.

concepts.title: India's location and latitude lines
concepts.body:
• India lies entirely in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres.
  • The Tropic of Cancer (23½°N) passes through 8 states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.
  • Indian Standard Time is based on 82°30′E, which passes near Mirzapur (Uttar Pradesh). IST is 5 h 30 min ahead of GMT.
  • Largest state by area: Rajasthan. Longest coastline: Gujarat.

concepts.title: Rivers of India
concepts.body:
• Himalayan rivers (Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra) are perennial — fed by snow and rain.
  • The Ganga is formed at Devprayag where the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet. It is India's longest river.
  • The Brahmaputra is called Tsangpo in Tibet.
  • Peninsular rivers: Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna and Kaveri flow east to the Bay of Bengal and form deltas. Narmada and Tapi flow west through rift valleys into the Arabian Sea and form estuaries.
  • Godavari is the longest peninsular river ('Dakshin Ganga'). Narmada rises at Amarkantak.

concepts.title: Soils and the atmosphere
concepts.body:
SoilKey fact
AlluvialMost widespread soil in India; very fertile (northern plains)
Black (regur)Holds moisture; best for cotton (Deccan plateau)
RedRed colour from iron oxide
LateriteFormed by heavy leaching in high-rainfall areas
Layers of the atmosphere from the ground up: Troposphere → Stratosphere → Mesosphere → Thermosphere → Exosphere. Weather happens in the troposphere; the ozone layer is in the stratosphere.

varieties.name: India: location, soils, atmosphere

example.q: Which soil is best suited for growing cotton?
steps: Cotton needs soil that holds moisture
Black (regur) soil of the Deccan holds moisture

example.q: Which river flows westward into the Arabian Sea?

varieties.name: World geography
varieties.how: Learn the superlatives table; read the question carefully for 'hot' desert or 'deepest' vs 'highest'.

steps: Pacific covers about a third of Earth's surface

tips: Tropic of Cancer states, west to east: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram.
West-flowing peninsular rivers = Narmada and Tapi (N–T); all big ones else flow east.
Ozone is in the stratosphere; weather is in the troposphere.
traps: Odisha and Bihar are NOT crossed by the Tropic of Cancer.
Godavari, not Krishna, is the longest peninsular river.
West-flowing Narmada and Tapi form estuaries, not deltas.

questions.q: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is built on which river?
questions.solution:
Bhakra Nangal Dam is on the Sutlej river (Himachal Pradesh–Punjab).
Memory hook: Two Punjab dams, two rivers: Bhakra on Sutlej, Pong on Beas.

questions.q: Which is the longest river in the world?
questions.solution:
The Nile (Africa) is generally taken as the longest river in the world; the Amazon carries the most water.
Memory hook: Nile = Length, Amazon = Amount of water.

questions.q: In which layer of the atmosphere is the ozone layer found?
questions.solution:
The ozone layer lies in the stratosphere and absorbs harmful ultraviolet rays.
Memory hook: Stratosphere Shields us from UV.

questions.q: Which of these rivers flows westward into the Arabian Sea?
questions.solution:
Tapi and Narmada flow west through rift valleys into the Arabian Sea. Godavari, Krishna and Mahanadi flow east into the Bay of Bengal.
Memory hook: N–T go West (Narmada, Tapi).

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which state?
questions.solution:
The Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram. Odisha lies south of it.
Memory hook: The line jumps from Jharkhand to West Bengal — Odisha is left below.

questions.q: Black soil is also known as:
questions.solution:
Black soil is called regur (or black cotton soil). It holds moisture and suits cotton. Bhangar and Khadar are old and new alluvium.
Memory hook: Regur — 'Real cotton grower'.

questions.q: At which place do the Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet to form the Ganga?
questions.solution:
The Bhagirathi and Alaknanda meet at Devprayag (Uttarakhand); from here the river is called the Ganga.
Memory hook: The holy river is born at the 'Dev' (god) prayag.

questions.q: The Indian Standard Time meridian (82°30′E) is ahead of Greenwich Mean Time by:
questions.solution:
Earth turns 1° in 4 minutes. 82.5° × 4 min = 330 min = 5 h 30 min.
Memory hook: 82.5 × 4 = 330 minutes.
